resources.string: Tap the accessibility button to switch between a dimmed screen and normal brightness. Set the amount of dimming in the Dimmer app. Dimmer does not read screen content.
Tap the button below, choose Dimmer and turn it on.
On the same screen, turn on the Dimmer shortcut and choose Accessibility button.
Tap the accessibility button to switch between dimmed and normal. Set the amount of dimming below.

If Dimmer is greyed out or shows \"Restricted setting\" (Android 13 and newer): open Settings > Apps > Dimmer, tap the three-dot menu at the top right and choose Allow restricted settings. Then turn Dimmer on again. The menu option only appears after you have tried to turn Dimmer on once.
